prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1051; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss by phone from the insured driver. Side impact at signalized intersection, driver's side of insured vehicle struck by a vehicle entering from cross street. Police report requested. Insured reports no visible injury at scene but advises a possible knee strike against the door frame.

Entry 2: Contacted the other driver's carrier to confirm liability position. Carrier indicates their insured disputes the signal phase. Scene photos and vehicle damage photos uploaded to file. Recorded statement scheduled with insured for next business day.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. All further contact to go through the attorney's office per their letter of representation. Attorney's office reports client has ongoing knee pain and has been referred for imaging. Requested medical records and billing authorization.

Entry 4: Reviewed traffic camera request response. Footage from the intersection is no longer retained by the municipality. Noted for file. Independent appraiser assigned to vehicle damage; estimate pending. Counsel's office asked for preliminary demand package, advised it will be reviewed once records are received.

Entry 5: Received medical records from treating provider. Diagnosis includes knee contusion with ongoing swelling; follow-up orthopedic evaluation recommended. Supervisor notified that claim involves bodily injury and represented claimant, reserves to be reviewed at next committee meeting. Diary set for follow-up with counsel in two weeks.
